title: Lightning Strikes the Earth 100 Times a Second
hook: Lightning strikes the Earth 100 times every second
script: Lightning strikes the Earth 100 times every second This constant violence is hidden from us The same lightning that can kill also shapes our planet What if you could see every lightning strike on Earth at once? Somewhere on Earth, right now, lightning is striking about a hundred times over
